statements.text: The side of Earth facing the Sun has daytime.
Earth's rotation moves each place into and out of the side facing the Sun.
Day and night are caused by Earth completing one orbit around the Sun each day.

stem:
Aisha notices it can be daytime where she is while it is night in another place on Earth at the same moment.

Which statements are correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Day and night happen because rotation carries each place into and out of the Sun-facing side. An orbit each day is the wrong mechanism.
